intro.text: Ham's wife, a seamstress raising their two children outside Luthadel, away from his underground life.

items.text: Married Ham and had two children. She kept clear of his shadier dealings by living in a satellite city of Luthadel and never got to know his crew. She worked as a seamstress to keep up appearances and told people Ham served in the Luthadel Garrison, while he worked towards moving the family out of the Central Dominance.
She and the children survived the final catastrophe and were reunited with Ham before the survivors climbed out of the caves where they had sheltered.
